p.title: v59.99 the chat evidence filter deleted a current sentence even when its number was the injected one
p.symptom: On a current-sensitive answer "NVDA는 180.25달러로, 천천히 분할 매수하기 좋은 구간입니다" lost the whole sentence, judgement included, although 180.25 USD was the injected price row; the prompt also told the model to keep current numbers out of prose.
p.root_cause: buildPublishableAnswerPlan's sentence stripper removed every sentence whose numericClaimKind was 'current' without comparing its figures with the publishable evidence rows it already held; a table cell became 확인 필요 the same way, and the answer-plan contract asked for current numbers only in claims.
p.fix: publication.js gains supportedNumbersFromEvidence(rows) (the numeric value and unit of each publishable raw-scale row) and figuresSupported(text, numbers): every figure written in the text must equal a supported value in a printed form (180.25 → 180.25/180.3/180) with the written sign and an agreeing unit; an integer under 100 needs a written unit that agrees, and counts and 조/억/만 magnitudes are never supported. A current sentence or table cell is kept only when all of its figures are supported, and an event sentence whose figures are all supported counts as bound. With no numeric rows the behaviour is unchanged. The answer-plan contract now lets injected and searched figures appear in their sentences with their date or basis and forbids a figure that is not in that material.
p.violated_rule: C16 / R687: a current figure must exist in the evidence the model was given; one that does exist is not an unbound claim.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check v59.99 (plan 044) cases drive the helper and buildPublishableAnswerPlan with a 180.25 USD price row and a -1.2% change row: supported sentences and cells kept, unsupported or mixed ones removed, no-row behaviour unchanged, the fallback path with rows following the same rule.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs exit 0; against the previous publication.js the same gate fails 8 plan-044 checks, including both kept sentences.

changelog: **A number that is in the evidence stays in its sentence ({P}):** a current-sensitive chat answer now removes a sentence only when one of its current figures is not in the injected evidence, so a judgement written next to the injected price is no longer deleted with it.
note: v59.99: plan 044 Part A — supported numbers keep their sentences
